Imagine never needing anyone to tell you that you're right.

Kevin Trudeau paints a picture of being supremely confident without being arrogant. In it, you never need to be validated, never need to convince anyone or prove anything, and never need to argue or debate.

He describes not needing to be recognized or given credit, and not being affected by what someone says or does to you.

Which of these would change your day the most?

#ad #confidence #mindset #freedom
